A vibrant rainbow arching over a large wooden ark resting on a rocky mountain. In the foreground, Noah, an older bearded man, looks up at the rainbow with his arms raised in thanksgiving, surrounded by various pairs of animals (lions, elephants, doves) and his family.

A dramatic biblical scene at the foot of a rugged, smoky mountain. Moses, dressed in robes, stands beside a stone altar with 12 small stone pillars around it. He is holding a basin and tossing red blood toward a large crowd of Israelites who are raising their hands in agreement.
